observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a red leather sofa with visible creases and folds, especially on the backrest and armrests. The material appears to be genuine leather with a slight sheen.

Photo 1 shows the full sofa from the front, placed on a patterned rug. The sofa has two seat cushions, two back cushions, and two armrests. The armrests are dark-colored, possibly black or dark brown, contrasting with the red upholstery.
The sofa appears to be in used condition with visible wear, including creases, scuffs, and some discoloration on the backrest.
No visible brand or model markings are present on the sofa in either photo.
The seller claims it is a '2 seater double seater leather sofa in good condition'.

Photos show visible creases, folds, and some discoloration, but no close-up of the underside or internal mechanisms. The condition cannot be fully assessed from the current photos.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.

risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly stained or degraded

risks.risk: Missing or damaged armrests or backrest components

A close-up of the upholstery under direct light to check for stains or cracking.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
